## 0.5.0

- Meeting notes (beta). Turn on Meetings in More settings, then start notes from the tray or the new Meetings page. Dicta records you and the call (Zoom, Google Meet, Discord) or just your microphone for in-person meetings, and writes the transcript on your PC as you talk.
- After the meeting you get topic sections, and with your Groq key a summary with decisions, action items and open questions, plus "Ask about this meeting". Dicta asks once before sending a transcript to Groq; without Groq you still get the transcript, topics, search and export.
- Private notes: while a meeting records, hold your Dicta key to save a note ("highlight this", "the deadline moved") that stays out of the transcript and shapes the summary. You can turn this off in Meetings settings.
- A recording indicator is always on screen while a meeting records, and Dicta warns you if it can't hear your microphone or the call.
